svg.text: IOD Quadrant Layout — 1 GPU per Quadrant
Supermicro AS-8126GS-TNMR · Verified via /sys/class/iommu/ivhd* device ownership
2 NUMA nodes · 4 GPUs/node · matchAttribute: numaNode = socket-level (coarse)
4 NUMA nodes · 2 GPUs/node · matchAttribute: numaNode = quadrant-pair (medium)
8 NUMA nodes · 1 GPU/node · matchAttribute: numaNode = pcieRoot equivalent (finest)
NPS4 NUMA Layout — each quadrant = 1 NUMA node = 1 GPU
Key: Under NPS4, matchAttribute: numaNode gives identical results to matchAttribute: pcieRoot — both yield 1 GPU per group.
